title: Freshness on the shared stack: TTL by default, targeted per-tenant purges with a per-call cap, never a wildcard
description:
Outcome: Implements PPY-05ebd5 for the shared stack. Today a publish that touches more than 10 paths becomes one "/*" invalidation (docs/site-hosting.md, "Targeted invalidation, one call per run"); on a shared distribution "/*" would empty every tenant's cache. On the shared stack: (1) default consistency is the TTL (one hour, s-maxage=3600; owner rule), with no purge on save; (2) explicit update-live and refresh calls (src/papyrus_content/page_refresh) purge exact paths for that tenant only (scoped per PPY-3b3cc3), keep the 25-path per-call cap and the dry run above 5 paths; (3) the publish path never collapses to a wildcard; (4) each purged path is metered to the tenant (PPY-3fd951); (5) the weekly path alarm (Papyrus/Edge InvalidatedPaths) gets a tenant dimension. The 1,000 free paths a month are per AWS account, so they are not promised to any tenant.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/page_refresh/service.py and operations.py (guard, _invalidate), src/papyrus_content/edge_invalidation.py, the projection's publish invalidation, amplify/publication/invalidation-alarm.ts, amplify/revalidate-invalidation-settings.ts, docs/site-hosting.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/shared-stack-freshness.feature):
Scenario: A save does not purge on the shared stack
    Given "alpha" saves a published story
    When the projection writes the page
    Then no invalidation is requested and the page is fresh at the edge within the TTL

Scenario: An explicit update-live purges only the tenant's exact paths
    Given "alpha" runs update-live for a story touching 8 paths
    When it confirms the dry run
    Then 8 exact paths of alpha are purged, metered to alpha, and no wildcard is sent

Scenario: A large publish never becomes a wildcard
    Given a publish on the shared stack touching 40 paths
    When it finishes
    Then no "/*" invalidation is sent

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-3b3cc3, PPY-3bbbf9. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-05ebd5, PPY-409932.

Testing: pytest on the guard and the path builder; a staging CloudTrail check that no wildcard invalidation was made.
Rollout: Shared stack only; dedicated sites keep their setting.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: tenants expect instant updates. Mitigation: the newsroom says 'live within an hour; Update live now for urgent changes' and update-live is one button.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
